lines: Rahul Bahri, Investor Selling Shareholder, has up to ₹0.24 crore from selling up to 1,800 shares in the offer; proceeds are in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago).
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, a recent trigger making this a timely call about the offer.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹0.57 crore, valued at offer price; the gain is up to ₹0.18 crore before offer expenses and taxes.
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, holdings found in one section only (promoter_holding).
